# Windows x64 portable preview

Download **LanguageLens-VERSION-windows-x64-preview.zip**, extract the complete folder, and open **LanguageLens.exe**. No Python, Git, or administrator access is required.

Choose your languages and use **Download required files** once. Optional voices are separate downloads. Capture, translation, and speech then run locally.

## Changes

Describe user-visible changes here. Include a clear before/after when a fix needs context.

## Update

Quit Lens from the tray and extract a new complete folder. Keep existing per-user settings/models/voices; do not mix files from different releases. Run **Check required files** if requested.

## Known limits

This preview is unsigned. Clean-machine Windows validation remains pending. Desktop and borderless-windowed capture are most dependable; Lens does not pause other apps.
